test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 16th November 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: A and B can complete a piece of work in 120 days. B and C can complete it in 150 days, and A and C can complete it in 200 days. In how many days can B alone complete two-fifths of the same work?
solution:
Given: 

A and B can complete a work in 120 days. 

B and C can complete it in 150 days.

A and C can complete it in 200 days.

Concept used:

Total work = Work done per day × Total time taken 

Calculation:

LCM (120, 150, 200) = 600 units

Let, Total work = LCM of the time taken by different workers

The efficiencies of A, B, and C be denoted by a, b, and c.

So, Total work = 600 units

Let the efficiencies of A, B, and C be denoted by A, B, and C.

According to the question,

a + b = 600/120

⇒ a + b = 5 ---(1)

b + c = 600/150

⇒ b + c = 4 ---(2)

a + c = 600/200

⇒ a + c = 3 ---(3)

Equation (1) + Equation (2) + Equation (3),

⇒ a + b + b + c + a + c = 5 + 4 + 3

⇒ 2(a + b + c) = 12

⇒ (a + b + c) = 12/2

⇒ (a + b + c) = 6 ---(4)

Subtracting equation (4) from equation (3),

(a + b + c) - (a + c) = 6 - 3

⇒ a + b + c - a - c = 3

⇒ b = 3

Now, the time taken by B to complete 2/5th of the work

⇒ {(2/5) × 600}/3

⇒ {1200/5}/3

⇒ 240/3 = 80 days

**∴ In 80 days B can alone complete two-fifths of the work.**
